classification.difficultyReason: Select straight-angle or complete-turn totals and solve equations with repeated unknown sectors.

spec.description: Shared horizontal baseline with two marked vertices. Left upper-left ray carries adjacent 62° and d° arcs; right upper-right ray carries 130° and 50° arcs.
spec.answerVisibility: All four source labels retained; no answer shown.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}d+62&=180\\d&=118\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal baseline, marked vertex, two rising rays with a right-angle square between them and t° arcs adjacent to the baseline.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}t+90+t&=180\\2t+90&=180\\2t&=90\\t&=45\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Marked vertex on a horizontal line; descending-right ray. Lower-left broad arc x°+50° and lower-right arc x°.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+x+50&=180\\2x+50&=180\\2x&=130\\x&=65\end{align*}$$
The other labelled angle is $65^\circ+50^\circ=115^\circ$.

spec.description: Leftward and upper-right rays meet at a dot. Upper 120° arc and complementary reflex arc below and right labelled 3h°.
spec.mathematics: 120+3h=360; h=80 and the marked reflex angle is 240°.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}120+3h&=360\\3h&=240\\h&=80\end{align*}$$
The marked reflex angle is $240^\circ$.

spec.description: Horizontal and rising diagonal lines cross at a dot. Upper-right arc 51° and lower-right obtuse arc a°.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+51&=180\\a&=129\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Four separate arms at a dot: shallow upper-left, steep upper-right, lower-right and steep lower-left. Top arc 108°, right-angle square at right, bottom and left arcs s°.
spec.mathematics: 108+90+s+s=360. Opposite arms are not imposed as collinear.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}108+90+s+s&=360\\2s+198&=360\\2s&=162\\s&=81\end{align*}$$
